results.title: Waldo V2 : Waldo Testing Forums | Product Hunt
results.content:
Title: Waldo V2 : Waldo Testing Forums | Product Hunt
The developer tool to speed up testing your mobile app, and squash bugs as a team! Waldo is a testing solution that takes away one challenge from the equation: automation. Once setup Waldo, anyone on your team can create tests in minutes so teams can spend less time automating tests, and ship cool bug-free updates, faster. Waldo is the product I’ve been wishing for since I started in mobile development over a decade ago. Before Waldo, I couldn’t find any product that ”just worked” when I needed to do UI testing. So when @amine\_bellakrid and @laurentsigal asked me to help make Waldo a reality, I jumped in with both feet! That was over three years ago and here we are now with Waldo V2! It is truly an amazing product (and some of the most challenging and rewarding work I have ever done). We being using it at work to solve many problems from analytics to UI changes and testing of it! WE are glad to count you amongst our customers, please keep giving us feedback! Today we are announcing the biggest update we have ever shipped: - Test your mobile analytics (Hello Product teams ;)) - Watch your recorded sessions - Organize your tests with group tests - Make sure you tests are automatable with Flaky Detection & Test Validation With these major updates we are launching a new product: Waldo Live. Waldo Live allows you to inspect your network calls, analytics, logs on the fly, it is the best replacement for Charles Proxy. Thank you to all our customers and product hunt community for the feedback! @jesus\_perea\_villegas I'm so grateful to be able to work hand to hand with amazing customers! Amazing product - it's a definitive must have for any team managing a mobile app! We been using Waldo for a while - we are a Latam company that has not only shifting from Website only, to Mobile and Website too! We do really enjoy working with Waldo - and If you wanna know, we DON'T have a QA Team - our QA team is Waldo.
